scope: Isolated loopback HTTP research service over the existing real processor; production app and model qualifications remain unchanged
source_age: Omitted remains unknown; an explicit user-provided photo age uses SourceAge.user and is never inferred from a filename
private_input: The user has supplied their own local photo and its age for local verification. Exact path, age, pixels and all derived assets stay in ignored research evidence; no private asset publication
source_builder: Caller-owned verified detector/reconstructor prepare full source context and fixed common UV; no implicit model loader in the HTTP app
service_owner: ResearchAgingService owns processor, session cache, coordinator, bounded stage metadata and response leases; caller owns reconstruction models
admission: One native admission shared by source builder, direct staging/registration and the actual processor injected into Coordinator. It remains owned after HTTP timeout/disconnect until native work ends
session_cache: Reuse bounded AgingSessionCache, absolute TTL and pinned accounting; result bytes are stored once, by session and condition
stage_index: At most4 opaque stage metadata records, checked against source/target TTL and source ownership. No unbounded job/result registry
asset_delivery: At most4 concurrent response leases; source/condition assets and stage preview/fit remain pinned until send finishes or is cancelled
review: Explicit source, PNG and fit SHA256 plus same-size binary disjoint masks; missing or mismatched review never becomes an automatic mask
absolute_age: Reuse Coordinator: unknown source fails before cache/worker; exact known source age returns original bytes; other fractional ages fail; reviewed integer results can be cache hits

http.upload: Raw bounded JPEG/PNG/WebP body, optional strict decimal source_age query; no multipart or disk spool
http.headers: Existing Host/Origin allowlist, no-store and nosniff middleware; default HTTP deadline180seconds
http.error_handling: Private-safe codes, no model paths/photo contents in HTTP errors
http.disconnect: Stop the request waiter; never cancel/release the actual native owner's source lease early

shutdown: Reject new work, close worker/processor and drain native/source work, then close Coordinator/cache. Already sending response leases stay charged until actual send completion or cancellation; cancelling a close waiter must not cancel cleanup

validation.synthetic: Controlled native barriers, TTL, timeout/disconnect, concurrent source/target admission, result ownership, assets and close; never labelled real inference
validation.real: User-consented local input, actual loopback server and HTTP requests, original source reset, new target generation/refit, explicit reviewed registration, cache hit and normal worker/server/model release
validation.frozen_evidence: Input/model/code/environment hashes before inference and checked after; first failures retained
validation.quality: Service wiring and local research only; same-age drift and generated identity are observations, not accepted model quality
